description: Dover Corporation is a diversified global manufacturer and solutions provider delivering innovative equipment and components, consumable supplies, aftermarket parts, software and digital solutions and support services through five operating segments: Engineered Products, Clean Energy & Fueling, Imaging & Identification, Pumps & Process Solutions, and Climate & Sustainability Technologies. Incorporated in 1947 in the State of Delaware and a publicly traded company since 1955, it is headquartered in Downers Grove, Illinois and currently employs approximately 24,000 people worldwide. Its five segments are structured around businesses with similar business models, go-to-market strategies, product categories and manufacturing practices, which increases management efficiency and better aligns its operations with its strategic initiatives and capital allocation.
